description: Pinned Douyin Android CLI using native UI for public search submission, visible results, feed text and bounded navigation.

analysis.recipe: Extend the retained adapter using existing REA evidence and retained native observations. Actual SearchResultActivity.onBackPressed source contains SearchBackServiceImpl interception, searchResultFragment.Bq(true), and other early returns before super.onBackPressed(). Preserve bounded navigation with fresh observation after each action and extend it to results. Retained native results expose query 西湖风景, 综合, ump layout control, scrollable lfp list, desc captions, aca authors and wbl dates. The failed independent input-page observation also contains lfp, so input classification excludes results-specific layout/tab controls instead of that shared container. Keep scrollable in native projections for independent matches against the results-list predicate. search.submit uses SDK inputText, then touchSelector on enabled xc2 搜索 because its observed clickable attribute is false with no clickable ancestor. Wait for exact query, distinct results controls, scrollable list and actual nonempty caption text. Project only freshly observed native result text. Native home exposes mgg video view, title author and desc caption. feed.next performs one bounds-derived upward swipe and requires both author and caption to change; no backend video identity is claimed. Runtime uses native UI only; no private backend API or signature bypass was recovered. User reports logged out; runtime authentication remains independently unconfirmed. Service/login barriers cause failure with actual observed text. Home cleanup restores the landing screen only, not feed identity, suggestions or history. The caller explicitly replaced the earlier erroneous test oracle; the reviewed journey is retained unchanged and acceptance remains for the outer runner.

sidebar.open.description: Open sidebar from home and verify native title, history and close controls.

sidebar.close.description: Return from sidebar to verified home; idempotent on home.
